signals.title: EUR/AUD — G10 Bilateral Theme + Policy Divergence
signals.text: EUR/AUD closed Friday at 1.6031; severe G10 divergence favors extended downside toward 1.5900. AUD 1W average gain of +0.981% across 4 pairs contrasts with EUR's laggard drop of -0.663% across 9 pairs (1.643% spread), while the AONIA vs €STR carry gap delivers +216bp in AUD's favor alongside RBA-ECB real policy rate divergence (+0.60% vs +0.30%). The ECB meeting on 29 Oct determines whether policy divergence widens further. Trade bias: Bearish EUR/AUD into the Sydney open. Catalyst: Sydney session open at 21:00 UTC followed by the ECB meeting on 29 Oct. Risk: RBA dovish pivot or a break back above the 1.6200 handle invalidates the downside bias.

signals.title: EUR/USD — COT Short Crowding + Fed-ECB Carry Divergence
signals.text: EUR COT LF net short stands at -82.4k contracts (52-week percentile 6, z=-1.65) after shedding -23.6k on the week, creating heavy trend-following downside pressure toward 1.1150 following Friday's close at 1.1206. Widening SOFR-€STR rate differentials (+144bp in USD's favor) reinforce dollar strength as US 10-year yields hold at 5.244% in a bear flattener regime. The Fed meeting on 28 Oct is the catalyst that resolves the policy spread into late month. Trade bias: Bearish EUR/USD into the open. Catalyst: next Fed meeting (mkt: 41% hike priced) on 28 Oct. Risk: Short-covering squeeze pushing spot above the 20-day SMA at 1.1384.
evidence: OIS carry: SOFR 3.88% vs ESTR 2.44% (+144bp favoring USD)

signals.title: USD/CAD — Employment Shock + Retail Asymmetry Squeeze
signals.text: CAD COT LF net short of -72.5k contracts expanded by -23.4k WoW, establishing upside continuation risk toward 1.4350 following Friday's 1.4255 close. The unexpectedly steep loss of 68.3k Canadian jobs compounds a +159bp SOFR-CORRA carry disadvantage against the USD, while retail positioning remains heavily short at 96% creating contrarian squeeze conditions. The BoC meeting on 28 Oct is the catalyst that resolves the policy trajectory. Trade bias: Bullish USD/CAD into the open. Catalyst: next BoC meeting (mkt: 47% hike priced) on 28 Oct. Risk: Spot failure below the 20-day SMA support at 1.4105.

signals.title: AUD/USD — Crowded Speculative Long Unwind Risk
signals.text: AUD COT LF net long of +55.1k contracts (72.3% long, 52-week percentile 79) presents positioning liquidation vulnerability following Friday's close at 0.6990. Despite a +72bp AONIA-SOFR carry premium favoring the Aussie, spot trades below all major daily moving averages (20-day SMA at 0.7042, 200-day SMA at 0.7039), and options 25-delta risk reversals exhibit persistent put skew (-1.04). The RBA meeting on 3 Nov determines whether the rate advantage sustains current elevation. Trade bias: Bearish AUD/USD into the Sydney open. Catalyst: Sydney open at 21:00 UTC followed by the RBA meeting on 3 Nov. Risk: Sustained close above the 200-day SMA at 0.7039.

signals.title: USD/JPY — Carry Advantage vs Put Skew Compression
signals.text: USD/JPY closed Friday at 158.29, where a +265bp SOFR-TONA carry advantage runs directly against an extreme 25-delta options put skew of -1.88. Persistent Japanese economic data underperformance (ESI -15.6) and BoJ-Fed real rate divergence (-2.25% vs +1.63%) sustain upward pressure, but option hedging signals elevated intervention risk near 159.00. The BoJ meeting on 30 Oct determines whether monetary policy normalisation limits dollar momentum. Trade bias: Neutral with a bullish tilt on USD/JPY. Catalyst: next BoJ meeting (mkt: 100% hold priced) on 30 Oct. Risk: Spot break below the 20-day SMA at 157.04.
evidence: OIS carry: SOFR 3.88% vs TONA 1.23% (+265bp favoring USD)
